_source: recorded 2026-10-28 in containers with --network none; three '/bin/sleep 30x &' jobs (PIDs 7, 8, 9 under the container's sh, PID 1) and each program called by name; stdout and stderr together, rc = exit status; the PIDs of pgrep / pidof themselves differ per run and are left out of the tests. busybox: busybox:1.36.1 sha256:73aaf090f3d85aa34ee199857f03fa3a95c8ede2ffd4cc2cdb5b94e566b11662 (v1.36.1), busybox:1.35 sha256:98ad9d1a2be345201bb0709b0d38655eb1b370145c7d94ca1fe9c421f76e245a (v1.35.0). busybox_1_33: busybox:1.33 sha256:f7ca5a32c10d51aeda3b4d01c61c6061f497893d7f6628b92f822f7117182a57 (v1.33.1; getopt prints the option without quotes). busybox_1_26: busybox:1.26 sha256:be3c11fdba7cfe299214e46edc642e09514dbb9bbefcd0d3836c05a1e0cd0642 (v1.26.2; no pgrep -a, usage 'Usage: pidof [OPTIONS] [NAME]...'). The usage of 1.25 equals 1.26's, 1.27.2 to 1.32.1 have -a and the old pidof usage, 1.33 the new (all recorded). 1.19.4 and 1.24.1 are not recorded: derived from their source (busybox.net, procps/pgrep.c, pidof.c: same option letters and usage text as 1.26). pidof: debian:12 sha256:854dd8ab51d62866dbd8f5431d15ce77b12983a2a4a1e1fe43a2395dc7ef9f61, debian:13 sha256:4c25275446ca371766b8b093c696782eabce06263fccacb8d5d813b3dc44b308 and ubuntu:24.04 sha256:24737cef17f4e22b1977df7d9a05e77c4e28b7da5b8911f8d8ccda136bf3573c print the same, ubuntu:22.04 (sha256:e0f80c829509ef4df9e76bd8944eb7b8ec25cbb379b112a7f9448b2c77a77c9b) the same -h text. pidof_el9: rockylinux:9 sha256:d7be1c094cc5845ee815d4632fe377514ee6ebcf8efaed6892889657e5ddaaa6 after dnf install procps-ng (3.3.17); its pidof listed none of the sleeps without -w (not understood, so the lists of that file are not used by the tests). pidof_sysvinit: centos:7 sha256:be65f488b7764ad3638f236b7b515b3678369a5124c47b8d32916d6487418ea4 after yum install sysvinit-tools (2.88; a pidof that is a link to killall5).
